name: AXM Module Lineage Comparator
actions: prove added removed changed and unchanged file paths by SHA-256
compare selected manifest and contract fields without semantic guessing
hold malformed unsafe oversized or digest-drifted bundles
export a lineage comparison only when an output path is explicit
summary: A deterministic two-bundle comparator that proves exact file and declared-contract differences without merging, choosing a winner, inferring freshness, staging, or installing.
notes: Integrated TEST module. Baseline and candidate are directional labels only; they never mean older, newer, safer, accepted, or CANON.
